name: racket-rally
summary: Count hits, bounces and rallies of a racket sport (tennis, badminton, table tennis, padel, squash) and who hit, from a fixed camera and its sound.

hardware.camera: a fixed camera that sees the whole court (gamst recipe check racket-rally --sport S --fps F says which frame rate the sport needs)
hardware.microphone: the camera's own sound or a microphone near the court (optional: --without onsets)
hardware.compute: one detector, one tracker and (sota) one ball model, each in its own environment; whether this Mac keeps up in realtime is measured at start (choose)

sota.summary: GAMST's pick per part (authors' numbers, not yet measured here): RF-DETR (Apache-2.0, COCO 56.5 AP at L), Roboflow trackers BoT-SORT (SportsMOT HOTA 73.8), TrackNetV3 ball heatmaps (MIT, shuttlecock F1 98.56); post adds the authors' temporal ensemble

roboflow.summary: Roboflow's own combination: RF-DETR detector, trackers ByteTrack, the ball as the detector's 'sports ball' followed by a gate (Roboflow Sports follows it with a small position filter)

ultralytics.summary: Ultralytics' own combination (its sports page): YOLO26 detecting players and the ball with Ultralytics' BoT-SORT tracker; COCO weights, Ultralytics publishes no sports weights (AGPL-3.0)

limits: a fixed camera; a ball the models do not see makes no contact (a sound alone never counts); hit = a break of the ball's image path near a player box, bounce = a downward-to-upward turn away from players, so a lob or a high bounce in a broadcast view can be confused; court positions only with --court; TrackNetV3's checkpoint is trained on badminton (shuttlecock) and is used for the other ball sports untrained
measured: 2026-11-28, OpenTTGames test_2 (table tennis, 30 s), GCP e2-standard-8 CPU, post at 60 fps: sota ball F1 0.84, bounces 19/28 (F1 0.67, 6.2 ms), 92.7x slower than the clip; roboflow ball F1 0.22, ultralytics 0.18. Realtime at 120 fps: no stack keeps up on that CPU (5-6 % of frames processed, gaps declared). docs/measurements/sports-2026-11-28.md
